text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see Jennifer.
source_text: You see Jennifer.

text: 你看见詹妮佛。
source_text: 你看见詹妮佛。

text: You see a Paladin.
source_text: You see a Paladin.

text: 你看见一名游侠。
source_text: 你看见一名游侠。

text: Excuse me, Brother. You should put away your weapon whenever# you are in the Brotherhood. We are a friendly order, but as# you know, times are rough.
source_text:
Excuse me, Brother. You should put away your weapon whenever
# you are in the Brotherhood. We are a friendly order, but as
# you know, times are rough.

text: 抱歉，一旦你走进了兄弟会，你要把你的武器收好。我们是个友好的组织，但是你也知道，现在的时局不太平。
source_text: 抱歉，一旦你走进了兄弟会，你要把你的武器收好。我们是个友好的组织，但是你也知道，现在的时局不太平。

text: Some members of the Brotherhood might be offended if a# stranger . . . I mean, a new Initiate . . . approaches them# with a weapon.
source_text:
Some members of the Brotherhood might be offended if a
# stranger . . . I mean, a new Initiate . . . approaches them
# with a weapon.

text: 如果一个陌生人……呃，我是说新兵……带着武器靠近某些兄弟会成员，他们会发火的。
source_text: 如果一个陌生人……呃，我是说新兵……带着武器靠近某些兄弟会成员，他们会发火的。

text: Good day, Initiate. How may I help you?
source_text: Good day, Initiate. How may I help you?

text: 你好，新兵，我能帮你什么呢？
source_text: 你好，新兵，我能帮你什么呢？

text: Hello, Sister, it's good to see there are women of rank in# this organization. I didn't know what to expect with a name like# the Brotherhood.
source_text:
Hello, Sister, it's good to see there are women of rank in
# this organization. I didn't know what to expect with a name like
# the Brotherhood.

text: 你好啊，姐妹。很高兴看到我们女同胞也进入了兄弟会。我都不知道以后兄弟会这个名字是不是要改改了。
source_text: 你好啊，姐妹。很高兴看到我们女同胞也进入了兄弟会。我都不知道以后兄弟会这个名字是不是要改改了。

text: Hey there, legs. You are looking mighty fine. What time should# I pick you up?
source_text:
Hey there, legs. You are looking mighty fine. What time should
# I pick you up?

text: 嗨，甜妞，你看起来不错，什么时候我带你耍？
source_text: 嗨，甜妞，你看起来不错，什么时候我带你耍？

text: Oooooga!
source_text: Oooooga!

text: 噢噢哦噢噢哦！
source_text: 噢噢哦噢噢哦！

text: Could you tell me where I might find our High Elder?
source_text: Could you tell me where I might find our High Elder?

text: 你知道我在哪里可以找到最高元老吗？
source_text: 你知道我在哪里可以找到最高元老吗？

text: Who's in charge of this hole?
source_text: Who's in charge of this hole?

text: 谁是这个破洞的管事？
source_text: 谁是这个破洞的管事？

text: Where's this High Elder guy?
source_text: Where's this High Elder guy?

text: 最高元老在哪里？
source_text: 最高元老在哪里？

text: Gruk!
source_text: Gruk!

text: 咕噜！
source_text: 咕噜！

text: Maxson, the High Elder, can be found on the Fourth Floor.# If you take the other elevator down to level four, he should# be either in the Council Room or the Elders's rooms.
source_text:
Maxson, the High Elder, can be found on the Fourth Floor.
# If you take the other elevator down to level four, he should
# be either in the Council Room or the Elders's rooms.

text: 最高元老马克松在第四层。你可以坐另外那部电梯下去。他应该在会议室或者元老室。
source_text: 最高元老马克松在第四层。你可以坐另外那部电梯下去。他应该在会议室或者元老室。

text: You can ask one of the guards on that level; they should know# where he is at the moment.
source_text:
You can ask one of the guards on that level; they should know
# where he is at the moment.

text: 你可以问问那层的守卫，他们应该知道他的下落。
source_text: 你可以问问那层的守卫，他们应该知道他的下落。

text: Thank you.
source_text: Thank you.

text: 谢谢。
source_text: 谢谢。

text: Where can I get some better weapons?
source_text: Where can I get some better weapons?

text: 我到哪里拿到更好的武器？
source_text: 我到哪里拿到更好的武器？

text: You should talk to Talus. He might be able to help you, or# at least tell you who to talk to.
source_text:
You should talk to Talus. He might be able to help you, or
# at least tell you who to talk to.

text: 你应该和塔鲁斯说说。他也许能帮你，或者至少他会告诉你去和谁说。
source_text: 你应该和塔鲁斯说说。他也许能帮你，或者至少他会告诉你去和谁说。

text: During the day, Talus is normally supervising in the training hall.# Do you know where that is?
source_text:
During the day, Talus is normally supervising in the training hall.
# Do you know where that is?

text: 白天的时候，塔鲁斯一般会在训练室督导，你知道训练室怎么走吧？
source_text: 白天的时候，塔鲁斯一般会在训练室督导，你知道训练室怎么走吧？

text: Yes, I do. Thank you.
source_text: Yes, I do. Thank you.

text: 知道，多谢了。
source_text: 知道，多谢了。

text: No.
source_text: No.

text: 不知道。
source_text: 不知道。

text: Of course I do!
source_text: Of course I do!

text: 我当然知道！
source_text: 我当然知道！

text: The training hall is right around the corner. Just go down this# corridor, make a left, go through the door at the end of# the corridor and it will be through the door on your right.
source_text:
The training hall is right around the corner. Just go down this
# corridor, make a left, go through the door at the end of
# the corridor and it will be through the door on your right.

text: 走廊拐过去就是训练室。顺着这条走廊走，左转，一直走到底，进门往右便是了。
source_text: 走廊拐过去就是训练室。顺着这条走廊走，左转，一直走到底，进门往右便是了。

text: You have been extremely helpful. Thank you very much.# I hope we can talk again soon. Good day.
source_text:
You have been extremely helpful. Thank you very much.
# I hope we can talk again soon. Good day.

text: 你说的太清楚了！谢谢谢谢！我待会再来和你聊，再见。
source_text: 你说的太清楚了！谢谢谢谢！我待会再来和你聊，再见。

text: Training hall? Do you think I could get some training there?# I am a member of the Brotherhood now, right?
source_text:
Training hall? Do you think I could get some training there?
# I am a member of the Brotherhood now, right?

text: 训练室？我可以在那里得到训练吗？我现在已经是兄弟会成员了啊，对吧？
source_text: 训练室？我可以在那里得到训练吗？我现在已经是兄弟会成员了啊，对吧？

text: Thank you for your help, Sister. It's good to see there are# women of rank in this organization. I didn't know what to# expect with a name like the Brotherhood.
source_text:
Thank you for your help, Sister. It's good to see there are
# women of rank in this organization. I didn't know what to
# expect with a name like the Brotherhood.

text: 谢谢你，姐妹。很高兴看到我们女同胞也进入了兄弟会。我都不知道以后兄弟会这个名字是不是要改改了。
source_text: 谢谢你，姐妹。很高兴看到我们女同胞也进入了兄弟会。我都不知道以后兄弟会这个名字是不是要改改了。

text: Thanks, Sugar. You know, you're looking mighty fine. What# do you say you and me check out each other's 'equipment'# later? What time do you get off?
source_text:
Thanks, Sugar. You know, you're looking mighty fine. What
# do you say you and me check out each other's 'equipment'
# later? What time do you get off?

text: 多谢甜心。你看起来很不错啊。要不我们找机会互相检查一下“装备”？你什么时候有空啊？
source_text: 多谢甜心。你看起来很不错啊。要不我们找机会互相检查一下“装备”？你什么时候有空啊？

text: Oh, that place. Okay, bye.
source_text: Oh, that place. Okay, bye.

text: 啊，那里，好，再见。
source_text: 啊，那里，好，再见。

text: Excuse me? Is there something wrong?
source_text: Excuse me? Is there something wrong?

text: 对不起，你有什么毛病吗？
source_text: 对不起，你有什么毛病吗？

text: Muk lug?
source_text: Muk lug?

text: 穆穆？
source_text: 穆穆？

text: I'm sorry, I don't think I can help you. You should go see the# doctor. She's on the second level.
source_text:
I'm sorry, I don't think I can help you. You should go see the
# doctor. She's on the second level.

text: 对不起，我帮不上你的忙，你应该去看看医生，她在第二层。
source_text: 对不起，我帮不上你的忙，你应该去看看医生，她在第二层。

text: Of course there are. Two of our five Elders are women, our master# scribe is a woman, and we have many other women in all the# different ranks.
source_text:
Of course there are. Two of our five Elders are women, our master
# scribe is a woman, and we have many other women in all the
# different ranks.

text: 没错，五大元老里有两人是女的，我们的首席研究员弗蕾也是女的，各个职位上都有我们女性。
source_text: 没错，五大元老里有两人是女的，我们的首席研究员弗蕾也是女的，各个职位上都有我们女性。

text: The women of the Brotherhood are also called Brothers. We don't call# the women Sisters. This is the Brotherhood of Steel, after all,# not the Brother and Sisterhood of Steel.
source_text:
The women of the Brotherhood are also called Brothers. We don't call
# the women Sisters. This is the Brotherhood of Steel, after all,
# not the Brother and Sisterhood of Steel.

text: 兄弟会的女性也要称呼为兄弟，我们不会姐姐妹妹的乱叫。这里毕竟是钢铁兄弟会，不是钢铁兄弟姊妹会什么的。
source_text: 兄弟会的女性也要称呼为兄弟，我们不会姐姐妹妹的乱叫。这里毕竟是钢铁兄弟会，不是钢铁兄弟姊妹会什么的。

text: Don't you find it peculiar that it is called the Brotherhood,# implying that its members consist solely of men?
source_text:
Don't you find it peculiar that it is called the Brotherhood,
# implying that its members consist solely of men?

text: 你不觉得叫钢铁兄弟会很特别吗？搞的好像这里只有男人似的。
source_text: 你不觉得叫钢铁兄弟会很特别吗？搞的好像这里只有男人似的。

text: But why is it called the Brotherhood, then?
source_text: But why is it called the Brotherhood, then?

text: 那么为什么要叫做兄弟会呢？
source_text: 那么为什么要叫做兄弟会呢？

text: Well, it just seemed strange.
source_text: Well, it just seemed strange.

text: 就是有点怪嘛。
source_text: 就是有点怪嘛。

text: I do not know. That has been our name all of my life. I'm sure# there is a reason for it.
source_text:
I do not know. That has been our name all of my life. I'm sure
# there is a reason for it.

text: 我也不知道，我出生以来他们一直是叫这个名字，这肯定是有原由的。
source_text: 我也不知道，我出生以来他们一直是叫这个名字，这肯定是有原由的。

text: I guess you're right.
source_text: I guess you're right.

text: 有道理。
source_text: 有道理。

text: Well, it still seems a little strange to me.
source_text: Well, it still seems a little strange to me.

text: 我还是觉得这个名字怪怪的。
source_text: 我还是觉得这个名字怪怪的。

text: That is strange. I've never really put much thought into it.# We've been the Brotherhood of Steel all of my life. Our# ancestors must have had a reason for naming it so.
source_text:
That is strange. I've never really put much thought into it.
# We've been the Brotherhood of Steel all of my life. Our
# ancestors must have had a reason for naming it so.

text: 是很怪，但我从来没怎么想过。我出生以来他们一直是叫这个名字，前人起这个名字肯定是有原因的。
source_text: 是很怪，但我从来没怎么想过。我出生以来他们一直是叫这个名字，前人起这个名字肯定是有原因的。

text: But that doesn't mean things can't change.
source_text: But that doesn't mean things can't change.

text: 这不代表以后不会改。
source_text: 这不代表以后不会改。

text: Yeah, you're probably right.
source_text: Yeah, you're probably right.

text: 嗯，你说的对。
source_text: 嗯，你说的对。

text: So, is there anything else I can help you with?
source_text: So, is there anything else I can help you with?

text: 那么我还能帮你什么？
source_text: 那么我还能帮你什么？

text: Yes, where can I find the High Elder?
source_text: Yes, where can I find the High Elder?

text: 我想找最高元老。
source_text: 我想找最高元老。

text: Where can I get better weapons?
source_text: Where can I get better weapons?

text: 我想要更好的武器。
source_text: 我想要更好的武器。

text: No, that's it. Bye.
source_text: No, that's it. Bye.

text: 没事了，再见。
source_text: 没事了，再见。

text: No, we're very strict when it comes to tradition. I don't think# it could ever be changed. It doesn't bother me at all to be# addressed as a Brother. That is curious, though.
source_text:
No, we're very strict when it comes to tradition. I don't think
# it could ever be changed. It doesn't bother me at all to be
# addressed as a Brother. That is curious, though.

text: 不会的，我们严格遵循传统，名字应该不会改变的。叫我兄弟我其实也无所谓了，虽然有点怪。
source_text: 不会的，我们严格遵循传统，名字应该不会改变的。叫我兄弟我其实也无所谓了，虽然有点怪。

text: I think I'll have a talk with Vree. She might be able to give# some insight as to why our ancestors decided to call us the# Brotherhood of Steel.
source_text:
I think I'll have a talk with Vree. She might be able to give
# some insight as to why our ancestors decided to call us the
# Brotherhood of Steel.

text: 我应该和弗蕾聊聊去，她应该知道为什么前辈们要起这样一个名字。
source_text: 我应该和弗蕾聊聊去，她应该知道为什么前辈们要起这样一个名字。

text: Who's Vree? One of the Elders?
source_text: Who's Vree? One of the Elders?

text: 谁是弗蕾？她是元老？
source_text: 谁是弗蕾？她是元老？

text: Vree's the Master Scribe. She is the one you should talk to# if you have any technical questions, but don't disturb her# during her meditations at night.
source_text:
Vree's the Master Scribe. She is the one you should talk to
# if you have any technical questions, but don't disturb her
# during her meditations at night.

text: 她是我们的首席研究员，如果你有技术问题，就应该去问她，但是不要在她冥想的时候去打搅她。
source_text: 她是我们的首席研究员，如果你有技术问题，就应该去问她，但是不要在她冥想的时候去打搅她。

text: She almost always stays in her room, which is also occupied# by the mainframe on the third floor.
source_text:
She almost always stays in her room, which is also occupied
# by the mainframe on the third floor.

text: 她永远都呆在自己的房间里，就在第三层的中央。
source_text: 她永远都呆在自己的房间里，就在第三层的中央。

text: Hole? How dare you talk like that about the Brotherhood.# You are a member of our order now, and should be proud# to be a member of the Brotherhood of Steel.
source_text:
Hole? How dare you talk like that about the Brotherhood.
# You are a member of our order now, and should be proud
# to be a member of the Brotherhood of Steel.

text: 破洞？你怎么这么说钢铁兄弟会？你是一名兄弟会成员了，你要对自己的组织怀有敬意！
source_text: 破洞？你怎么这么说钢铁兄弟会？你是一名兄弟会成员了，你要对自己的组织怀有敬意！

text: Proud? Why? You're all just a bunch of robotic hop-heads, hiding# from the real world. There's nothing to be proud of there.
source_text:
Proud? Why? You're all just a bunch of robotic hop-heads, hiding
# from the real world. There's nothing to be proud of there.

text: 敬意？为什么？你们就是一群机械化偏执狂，只会逃避世界。我对这里没什么敬意。
source_text: 敬意？为什么？你们就是一群机械化偏执狂，只会逃避世界。我对这里没什么敬意。

text: I'm sorry. I get a little carried away with myself# sometimes.
source_text:
I'm sorry. I get a little carried away with myself
# sometimes.

text: 对不起，我有时候说话挺没谱的。
source_text: 对不起，我有时候说话挺没谱的。

text: Yeah, right.
source_text: Yeah, right.

text: 啊，对。
source_text: 啊，对。

text: Well, I guess we all do sometimes.
source_text: Well, I guess we all do sometimes.

text: 人都有说漏嘴的时候吧。
source_text: 人都有说漏嘴的时候吧。

text: So who is in charge of this place?
source_text: So who is in charge of this place?

text: 那谁是这个地方的主管？
source_text: 那谁是这个地方的主管？

text: Yeah. Well, I've got to go.
source_text: Yeah. Well, I've got to go.

text: 你说的对，我走了。
source_text: 你说的对，我走了。

text: Maxson, the High Elder. He's on the fourth floor.
source_text: Maxson, the High Elder. He's on the fourth floor.

text: 高级元老马克松，在第四层。
source_text: 高级元老马克松，在第四层。

text: Well, you are cute . . . but I don't think so. I don't think# it would be a good idea to get involved with an outsider,# anyways. You are cute, though, and somewhat attractive.
source_text:
Well, you are cute . . . but I don't think so. I don't think
# it would be a good idea to get involved with an outsider,
# anyways. You are cute, though, and somewhat attractive.

text: 你是很帅……但是我不会和你那什么的。我想我不应该和一个外面来的人纠缠不清的。不过，你的确很帅，很有吸引力。
source_text: 你是很帅……但是我不会和你那什么的。我想我不应该和一个外面来的人纠缠不清的。不过，你的确很帅，很有吸引力。

text: I don't know if it's because you're an outsider or because# of your extreme . . . lack of tact? So, 'honey', is there# anything else I can do for you?
source_text:
I don't know if it's because you're an outsider or because
# of your extreme . . . lack of tact? So, 'honey', is there
# anything else I can do for you?

text: 这个……我不知道是因为你是外来的，还是因为你太过……那个……直率了。那么，“甜心”，我还能为你做什么呢？
source_text: 这个……我不知道是因为你是外来的，还是因为你太过……那个……直率了。那么，“甜心”，我还能为你做什么呢？

text: Yeah, uh, I guess. Uh, who's in charge around here?
source_text: Yeah, uh, I guess. Uh, who's in charge around here?

text: 啊，对。谁是这里的主管？

text: Uh, okay . . . um. How about some weapons then? Where can# I get my hands on some of those?

Uh, okay . . . um. How about some weapons then? Where can

text: Hmmph!

text: 呼呼！
source_text: 呼呼！

text: No.
source_text: No.

text: 没了。

That's . . . pretty funny. You are joking, I hope? Actually . . .
# don't answer that. I don't think I want to know.

source_text: 真是……有趣，你在开玩笑吧，是吧？实际上……不要这么说。我也不想知道了。

text: Yeah, REAL funny. Almost as much as your face!

text: 太有趣了，和你的脸蛋一样有趣！
source_text: 太有趣了，和你的脸蛋一样有趣！

text: Thanks a lot. That's exactly what I needed to hear right now.
source_text: Thanks a lot. That's exactly what I needed to hear right now.

text: 多谢，我就想知道这些了。
source_text: 多谢，我就想知道这些了。

text: I'm out of here.
source_text: I'm out of here.

text: 我走了。
source_text: 我走了。

text: I'm sorry. It's just that you outsiders have such a strange# way of talking to people sometimes. Is there anything I can# help you with?
source_text:
I'm sorry. It's just that you outsiders have such a strange
# way of talking to people sometimes. Is there anything I can
# help you with?

text: 对不起，你们外面来的和人说话都是这样怪怪的。我还能帮你什么？
source_text: 对不起，你们外面来的和人说话都是这样怪怪的。我还能帮你什么？

Well, I guess I should talk to this High Elder person.

source_text: 好，我就去见见这个高级元老。他在哪里？

text: I would like to get some better weapons. Who do I talk# to about that?
